explains: server.port changes in application.properties. Only the keys that make the path of a route are followed in the application configuration (server.servlet.context-path, spring.mvc.servlet.path, spring.webflux.base-path and a key that a mapping names in a placeholder). A port can change what every route does, and nothing says which: the run records a blocking config_not_followed for the file, reaches no route, and is not complete.

must_exclude.why: the key is not part of a route path and is not followed
